title: What If Earth Suddenly Stopped Spinning?
description:
What would really happen if Earth suddenly stopped spinning? The ground would halt, but the air and oceans would keep moving, with huge winds, drained seas and days that last a year.

#earth #science #whatif #physics #space

beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the ocean bump drifts to the side as the planet's day side keeps its lit half

beats.sentence: Right now, Earth's surface races along at about one thousand miles an hour at the equator.
beats.subject: gauge
beats.change: the needle swings up to one thousand miles an hour and the arc fills

beats.sentence: Here is what really happens: the ground would stop, but the air and the oceans would not.
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the air glow thickens and the ocean bump slides forward past the stopped surface

beats.sentence: Everything loose would keep its old speed and slide eastward across the ground.
beats.subject: rock
beats.change: the boulder lurches eastward and slides along the ground

beats.sentence: Near the equator, winds of about one thousand miles an hour would sweep across the land, stripping away soil, trees and buildings.
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the air glow flares bright and streaks sideways as the winds scour the surface

beats.sentence: The oceans would slosh forward, then drain toward the poles, because Earth would stay slightly bulged at the equator.
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the ocean bump slides from the equator up toward the north pole and grows

beats.sentence: That would leave a huge belt of dry land around the middle of the planet.
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the ocean shrinks away from the equator and bare land shows around the middle

beats.sentence: A single day would last a whole year, so one side would bake in sunlight for about six months while the other froze in darkness.
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the sun side stays lit and bright while the far side goes dark and cold

beats.sentence: It is like a bus braking hard: the bus stops, but everything inside keeps flying forward.
beats.subject: car
beats.change: the bus brakes to a halt while the crates inside slide forward

beats.sentence: Earth's slow, steady turn keeps our winds gentle, our oceans spread evenly, and our days short enough for life to thrive.
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the ocean bump spreads evenly again and the air glow settles to a calm soft haze

beats.sentence: If you had to survive it, where on Earth would you stand?
beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the planet's land belt and poles light up as possible places to stand

beats.subject: planet
beats.change: the whole planet glows warmer and the air glow brightens softly

notes: S3 (text): S3 "the ground would stop, but the air and the oceans would not": the text "1,000 mph at the equator" from S2 stays up while the gauge needle drops to zero, which could read as a mismatch. Fix: Note only: keep the text but make sure the gauge is clearly the ground speed.
